clockSleep.scope: Requested delay is sampled just before the existing call. Return lateness observes task resumption against its deadline, not kernel wake alone; wall includes suspension, executor resumption and bookkeeping. Observer work after return precedes the next tick. No CPU subtraction across suspension, new timer/wait or guarantee of on-time wake. Canceled returns are excluded from successful aggregates. Run-captured profile epoch atomically fences all new sleep events/aggregates against case reset; legacy counters are unchanged. Phase files still require completed case validation.
